# Pandas cookbook

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/nf/gen_cookbook.py from open_fdd/rules/cookbook_catalog.py and the unit tables. Do not edit by hand. -->

**71 rules as pandas functions**: the reference twin of the [SQL cookbook](sql-cookbook.html), for notebooks, CSV studies and
the parity tests ([parity](parity.html)). The function behind each rule is in
[`open_fdd/rules/cookbook_catalog.py`](https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/open_fdd/rules/cookbook_catalog.py). The 6 rules without a twin are marked **SQL only**.

**Conventions**

- Input is a `DataFrame` with a UTC `DatetimeIndex` and one Haystack-role column per signal, all in SI (table below).
  The rules never convert units or guess a scale.
- `run_rule(rule_id, df, params=..., poll_seconds=300)` returns `status` (`PASS`, `FAULT`, `SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES`, ...),
  `fault_hours` (h), and the `raw_fault` and `confirmed_fault` boolean masks. Set `df.attrs["equipment_id"]` and `df.attrs["equipment_type"]`.
- The runner applies the operational gate and the confirm delay (`confirm_min`, minutes). Parameter keys match the SQL catalog.

```python
import pandas as pd
from open_fdd.rules import run_rule

# one day on a 5-minute grid, UTC timestamps, every value SI (°C, Pa, L/s, kW; commands 0-1)
idx = pd.date_range("2026-01-05", periods=288, freq="5min", tz="UTC", name="timestamp_utc")
df = pd.DataFrame({"duct-static-pressure": 150.0, "duct-static-pressure-sp": 250.0, "fan-cmd": 1.0}, index=idx)
df.attrs.update(equipment_id="equip-1", equipment_type="AHU")

result = run_rule("FC1", df, params={"confirm_min": 5})
print(result.status, result.fault_hours)
```

Duct static (Pa) sits 100 Pa under its setpoint while the fan runs: low static at full fan.

## Units convention

- Rules compute in **SI only**. The engineer declares each point's unit in NF; ingest converts it to SI (`open_fdd/data/units.json`).
  Unknown or incompatible units are skipped, never guessed from the value.
- Imperial is display-only. Differences (Δ°C) convert with a factor of 1.8 and no +32.
- Fractions are 0-1, relative humidity is 0-100 %RH, statuses are 0/1.

| Quantity | SI unit (rules compute in this) | Imperial display | Also accepted (converted at ingest) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Temperature | °C | °F | °F, K |
| Temperature difference | Δ°C | Δ°F | Δ°F |
| Temperature rate | Δ°C/h | Δ°F/h | Δ°F/h |
| Air pressure | Pa | inH₂O | kPa, inH2O, psi, bar |
| Water pressure | Pa | psi | kPa, inH2O, psi, bar |
| Air flow | L/s | cfm | m³/s, m³/h, cfm, gpm |
| Water flow | L/s | gpm | m³/s, m³/h, cfm, gpm |
| Power | kW | kW | W, MW, Btu/h, ton, hp |
| Energy | kWh | kWh | Wh, MWh, kBtu, MMBtu, therm |
| Relative humidity | % | % | % (the SI unit only) |
| Concentration | ppm | ppm | none |
| Command or position | fraction, 0-1 | % | `%`, ratio |
| Status | 0/1 | 0/1 | `bool` |

AHU / RTU / MAU / DOAS: duct static, supply air, economizer, mixing and mode faults.


### AHU-DUCTHI {#ahu-ducthi}

Duct static > static SP + margin.

**Duct static pressure high** · **Family** ahu · **Equipment** `ahu` · **Confirm** 5 min · function `ahu_duct_high` · [SQL entry](sql-cookbook.html#ahu-ducthi)

**Equation**: Duct static > static SP + margin. Evaluates when fan is proven on OR duct static itself exceeds pressure_on_min (catches high static with fan-status off).

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | Quantity | SI unit | Also accepted (converted at ingest) | Expected range | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `duct_static` | `duct-static-pressure` | Pressure | Pa | kPa, inH2O, psi, bar | -248.84 to 1990.72 | required |
| `duct_static_sp` | `duct-static-pressure-sp` | Pressure | Pa | kPa, inH2O, psi, bar | - | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 5 | 0 | 60 | min |
| `duct_high_margin` | High margin | 62.21 | 12.442 | 248.84 | Pa |
| `pressure_on_min` | Pressure-on evidence | 49.768 | 12.442 | 248.84 | Pa |

### ECON-3 {#econ-3}

Flags mechanical cooling during web free-cool weather when the OA damper is not fully integrated.

**Mech cooling without integrated economizer** · **Family** ahu · **Equipment** `ahu` · **Confirm** 5 min · function `econ2` · [SQL entry](sql-cookbook.html#econ-3)

**Equation**: Web free-cooling opportunity: 15.6 °C ≤ dry-bulb < 22.2 °C AND dewpoint < 15.6 °C (dewpoint from web sensor or calculated from web DB+RH). Fault when cooling valve is open while OA damper is below the integrated-economizer threshold (default 90%). No BAS OAT fallback. Screenable engineering defaults — not code limits.

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | Quantity | SI unit | Also accepted (converted at ingest) | Expected range | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `oa_damper_pct` | `outside-air-damper` | Command or position | 0-1 | %, ratio | 0 to 1 | required |
| `clg_valve_pct` | `cooling-valve` | Command or position | 0-1 | %, ratio | 0 to 1 | required |
| `web_oa_t` | `web-outside-air-temp` | Temperature | °C | °F, K | - | optional |
| `web_oa_dp` | `web-outside-air-dewpoint` | Temperature | °C | °F, K | - | optional |
| `web_oa_h` | `web-outside-air-humidity` | Relative humidity | %RH (0-100) | none | 0 to 100 | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 5 | 0 | 60 | min |
| `econ3_damper_hi` | Integrated economizer damper | 0.9 | 0.5 | 1 | fraction (0-1) |
| `econ3_db_max` | Free-cool OA dry-bulb max | 22.2222 | 18.3333 | 26.6667 | °C |
| `econ3_db_min` | Free-cool OA dry-bulb min | 15.5556 | 10 | 20 | °C |
| `econ3_dp_max` | Free-cool OA dew point max | 15.5556 | 7.22222 | 20 | °C |

**Outputs** (the same as the SQL twin)

| Output | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equipment_id` | - | equipment the row describes |
| `fault_hours` | h | confirmed fault time |
| `covered_hours` | h | time the rule could assess (known inputs, gate open) |
| `fault_pct` | % | fault_hours as a share of covered_hours |

### ECON-7 {#econ-7}

Flags cooling demand during economizer-OK web weather (dew point < 15.6 °C, dry-bulb < 22.2 °C) while the OA damper is not economizing.

**Economizer OK but not economizing** · **Family** ahu · **Equipment** `ahu` · **Confirm** 10 min · function `econ7_compute` · [SQL entry](sql-cookbook.html#econ-7)

**Equation**: Economizer-OK web weather: dew point < 15.6°C AND dry-bulb < 22.2°C (above a 1.7°C freeze-guard floor; dewpoint from web sensor or calculated from web DB+RH). Fault when there is cooling demand (cooling valve open or proven DX/chiller cooling) but the OA damper stays below the economizing threshold (default 50%). Expected: economizer-only below 15.6°C DB (MECH-OAT-1) and mech + integrated economizer in the 15.6–22.2°C band (ECON-3). All temperature thresholds are SI.

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | Quantity | SI unit | Also accepted (converted at ingest) | Expected range | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `oa_damper_pct` | `outside-air-damper` | Command or position | 0-1 | %, ratio | 0 to 1 | required |
| `web_oa_t` | `web-outside-air-temp` | Temperature | °C | °F, K | - | optional |

### VAV-1 {#vav-1}

Flags occupied-band zone temperature violations.

**Zone comfort band** · **Family** vav · **Equipment** `vav`, `zone_other`, `heatpump`, `baseboard` · **Confirm** 15 min · function `vav1` · [SQL entry](sql-cookbook.html#vav-1)

**Equation**: Zone temp outside zone_lo–zone_hi (default 21.1–23.9 °C) during occupied hours when an occupancy column or Overview calendar is set (require_occupied, default on). Unoccupied setback stays on VAV-2.

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | Quantity | SI unit | Also accepted (converted at ingest) | Expected range | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `zone_t` | `zone-air-temp` | Temperature | °C | °F, K | 4.44 to 37.78 | required |
| `occ_mode` | `occupied` | Text | text | none | - | optional |
| `occ_mode` | `occupied` | Text | text | none | - | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 15 | 0 | 60 | min |
| `require_occupied` | Require occupied | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `zone_hi` | Zone high | 23.8889 | 22.2222 | 29.4444 | °C |
| `zone_lo` | Zone low | 21.1111 | 12.7778 | 22.2222 | °C |

**Outputs** (the same as the SQL twin)

| Output | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equipment_id` | - | equipment the row describes |
| `fault_hours` | h | confirmed fault time |
| `covered_hours` | h | time the rule could assess (known inputs, gate open) |
| `fault_pct` | % | fault_hours as a share of covered_hours |

**Parity** [match](parity.html#vav-1); differs only on edge data: Two input-handling differences: (1) NULL zone_t cells: SQL drops NULL rows (WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL) and holds the previous sample's state across the null run, pandas scores a NULL as not faulted; (2) planted out-of-range zone_t (80 degC): the pandas quality layer marks it OUT_OF_RANGE and excludes it, SQL scores the value as given.

**Equation**: Rolling 1h total variation of any 0–100% control output (dampers, valves, fan speeds, heat/cool cmds) with span ≥20%, TV ≥500 %·pts, ≥2.5 equivalent cycles, ≥4 reversals — suspected loop hunting (not proof of bad PID alone).

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | Quantity | SI unit | Also accepted (converted at ingest) | Expected range | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `loop_enabled` | `loop-enabled` | Status | 0/1 | bool | 0 or 1 | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `change_deadband_pct` | Ignore changes below | 1 | 0 | 10 | % out |
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | min |
| `minimum_coverage_pct` | Minimum data coverage | 80 | 25 | 100 | % |
| `minimum_equivalent_cycles` | Min equivalent cycles | 2.5 | 0.5 | 20 | cyc/h |
| `minimum_reversals` | Min direction reversals | 4 | 1 | 40 | count |
| `minimum_span_pct` | Minimum observed span | 20 | 5 | 100 | % out |
| `total_variation_fault_pct` | Total travel threshold | 500 | 50 | 2000 | %/h |

**Outputs** (the same as the SQL twin)

| Output | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equipment_id` | - | equipment the row describes |
| `fault_hours` | h | confirmed fault time |
| `covered_hours` | h | time the rule could assess (known inputs, gate open) |
| `fault_pct` | % | fault_hours as a share of covered_hours |

**Parity** [match](parity.html#pid-hunt-1)

### SV-RATE {#sv-rate}

Flags implausible sustained sensor rates of change using location- and state-aware thresholds.

**Context-aware sensor rate of change** · **Family** sensor · **Equipment** `ahu`, `vav`, `chiller`, `boiler`, `weather`, `zone_other`, `heatpump` · **Confirm** 10 min · function `_sv_rate_compute` · [SQL entry](sql-cookbook.html#sv-rate)

**Equation**: Implausible sustained rate-of-change for mapped sensors. Thresholds depend on quantity, location, and operating state (steady vs startup/shutdown transient). Engineering screening defaults — tune per site. Alias: SV-SLEW. Distinct from SV-SPIKE (one-sample jump), SV-RANGE, SV-FLATLINE, and PID-HUNT-1.

| `design_flow` | Design flow (flow profiles) | 0 | 0 | 47194.7 | L/s |
| `max_gap_hours` | Max sample gap | 2 | 0.25 | 6 | h |
| `persistence_min` | Fault persistence | 10 | 5 | 60 | min |
| `sensor_span` | Sensor span (flow/pressure) | 0 | 0 | 100000 | eng |
| `transition_window_min` | Transition window | 20 | 5 | 60 | min |

**Outputs** (the same as the SQL twin)

| Output | Unit | Meaning |

| `covered_hours` | h | time the rule could assess (known inputs, gate open) |

**Parity** [known divergence](parity.html#sv-rate): documented in sql/fdd/KNOWN_DIFFERENCES.md: pandas uses profile/median/persistence logic, SQL two consecutive exceedances

## Weather {#group-weather}

Web weather versus the site's own outside air sensor.


### OAT-METEO {#oat-meteo}

Flags large disagreement between BAS outdoor-air temp and web weather OAT.

**BAS outdoor-air sensor vs Open-Meteo** · **Family** ahu · **Equipment** `ahu` · **Confirm** 15 min · function `oat_vs_meteo` · [SQL entry](sql-cookbook.html#oat-meteo)

**Equation**: BAS OAT sensor differs from Open-Meteo dry bulb by more than 2.8 Δ°C.

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | Quantity | SI unit | Also accepted (converted at ingest) | Expected range | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `oa_t` | `outside-air-temp` | Temperature | °C | °F, K | -51.11 to 54.44 | required |
| `web_oa_t` | `web-outside-air-temp` | Temperature | °C | °F, K | - | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 15 | 0 | 60 | min |
| `oat_err` | Max OAT disagreement | 2.77778 | 1.11111 | 11.1111 | °C |
| `web_asof_margin_seconds` | Web as-of margin | 300 | 0 | 1800 | s |
| `web_cadence_seconds` | Web weather cadence | 1200 | 300 | 7200 | s |

**Outputs** (the same as the SQL twin)

| Output | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equipment_id` | - | equipment the row describes |
| `fault_hours` | h | confirmed fault time |
| `covered_hours` | h | time the rule could assess (known inputs, gate open) |
| `fault_pct` | % | fault_hours as a share of covered_hours |

**Parity** [known divergence](parity.html#oat-meteo): weather source: SQL prefers equipment web_oa_* then as-of weather rows; pandas resolves its own web columns


### WX-1 {#wx-1}

OAT sample-to-sample jump > 8.9 Δ°C.

**OA temperature spike** · **Family** weather · **Equipment** `weather` · **Confirm** 5 min · function `wx1` · [SQL entry](sql-cookbook.html#wx-1)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | Quantity | SI unit | Also accepted (converted at ingest) | Expected range | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `oa_t` | `outside-air-temp` | Temperature | °C | °F, K | -51.11 to 54.44 | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 5 | 0 | 60 | min |
| `spike_limit` | Spike limit | 8.88889 | 2.22222 | 22.2222 | °C |

**Outputs** (the same as the SQL twin)

| Output | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equipment_id` | - | equipment the row describes |
| `fault_hours` | h | confirmed fault time |
| `covered_hours` | h | time the rule could assess (known inputs, gate open) |
| `fault_pct` | % | fault_hours as a share of covered_hours |

**Parity** [match](parity.html#wx-1); differs only on edge data: Gap handling: SQL flags |oa_t - previous sample| above the fixed limit whatever the time between samples, pandas scales the limit by the sample gap (limit x dt/poll), so a real change across a >2 h gap is a spike in SQL only.
